transcript: 5 Barbie-inspired fashion trends Crafted from crocodile-effect leather, the pink downtown chain handle leather bag features a chunky silver chain strap with a logo print cover inspired by industrial hardware. Studded sleeveless denim gives a major ken vibe giving these vests over any outfit for instant laid-back texture. The fabric usually is a non-stretch 80% cotton and 20% polyester. Made up of high quality fabrics, slim fit dresses are extremely comfortable to wear. The dresses boast of an exclusive and classy appeal. The printed knot headbands are handmade and are elastic. The logo print high waisted crop trousers are cut for a flared leg. With these trends, you too can flaunt your passionate choices in front of the whole world.
metadata_caption:
Remember the time jab bachpann mein bachche khaas kar ladkiyaan apni barbie doll se khelti thi? The way they used to groom her was a site. Its style has inspired a whole new world of fashion called ‘Barbiecore’.
When you conjure up a mental image of Barbie, you probably think of bubblegum pink, the '80s zone feminine clothing. That's exactly what ‘Barbiecore’ aims to embody.
If you are a fan of the pink flare which Barbie brings, here are 5 Barbie-inspired fashion trends that you can surf.
